shortDescription: Perform a reboot of a Comware 7 device

options.name: date
options.description: Specify the date at which the reboot will take place. The time parameter is required to use this parameter. Format should be MM/DD/YYYY in quotes.

options.name: delay
options.description: Delay (in minutes) to wait to reboot the device

options.name: reboot
options.description: Needs to be set to true to reboot the device

options.name: time
options.description: Specify the time at which the reboot will take place. Format should be HH:MM enclosed in quotes.
